name: stream-error-partial-kept
description: A stream error in the order Studio's loop made the calls before harness slice J1.4: finishStream first, then setError. setError only removes a message that is still streaming, and finishStream has already let go of it, so the partial assistant turn (here, a tool call whose arguments were cut off) stays in the transcript and goes out on the next send. The loop now calls setError alone, which removes the partial, but a session saved by an earlier build still carries this shape.
script: Stream error: upstream closed the connection
